senses.gloss:
कुंश् कुंश् or कुंस्, cl. 1. or 10. P. कुंशति,
कुंशयति, or कुंसति, कुंसयति, -यितुम्,
to speak; to shine.
कुनक कुनक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

कुनख कु-नख, अस्, ई, अम् (see 1. कु), having
ugly nails; (अम्), n. a disease of the nails.

कुनट कुनट, अस्, m. a sort of trumpet
flower, Bignonia (श्योनाक-प्रभेद); (ई), f. a kind
of coriander, Coriandrum Sativum; red arsenic.

कुनदिका कु-नदिका, f. (see 1. कु), a small
river.

कुनादीका कु-नादीका, f. (see 1. कु), a small
river; also कु-नदिका, q. v.

कुनन्नम कु-नन्नम, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु
and rt. नम्), Ved. inflexible.

कुनलिन् कु-नलिन्, ई, m. (see 1. कु), the
plant Agati Grandiflora.

कुनह कुनह, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(a various reading for कुणप.)

कुनाथ कु-नाथ, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a bad
protector; (अस्, आ, अम्), having a bad leader.

कुनाभि कु-नाभि, इस्, m. (see 1. कु), a
whirlwind; the collective treasures of Kuvera.

कुनामन् कु-नामन्, आ, आ, अ (see 1. कु),
having a bad name; having a bad reputation; (आ),
m., N. of a man; (अ), n. a bad name, ill repute.

कुनायक कु-नायक, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु),
having a bad leader, unprotected.

कुनाल कुनाल, अस्, m. a kind of bird living
on the Himālaya; N. of a son of king Aśoka, named
after the eyes of this bird.

कुनालिक कुनालिक, अस्, m. the Indian
cuckoo or Kokila; [cf. the preceding.]

कुनाशक कु-नाशक, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), the
plant Alhagi Maurorum.
कुनि कुनि, इस्, m., N. of a prince.

कुनिषञ्ज कु-निषञ्ज, अस्, m. (see 1. कु),
N. of a son of the tenth Manu.

कुनीति कु-नीति, इस्, f. (see 1. कु), ill conduct,
misbehaviour; corrupt administration or policy, mis-
government; a low state of morals.
कुनेत्रक कु-नेत्रक, अस्, m., N. of a Muni.

कुन्त कुन्त, अस्, m. a spear, a lance, a
barbed dart [cf. Lat. contus; Gr. κοντός]; a small
animal, an insect; a species of grain, Coix Barbata;
passion; N. of a mountain.

कुन्तल, अस्, m. (fr. कुन्त?), the hair of the head,
a lock of hair; a drinking cup; a plough; barley;
a kind of perfume, = ह्रीवेर; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
people and country in the north-west of the peninsula;
(अस्), m. sing. the prince of this people.
—कुन्तल-
वर्धन, अस्, m., N. of a plant; [cf. भृङ्ग-
राज.]
—कुन्तलोशीर (˚ल-उश्˚), अम्, n. a perfume.

कुन्तलिका, f. a butter knife or scoop; a species
of plant.

कुन्ताप कुन्ताप, अम्, n., Ved., N. of certain
organs or glands (?), twenty in number, supposed to
be in the belly; N. of a section of the Atharva-veda,
according to Sāyaṇācārya, thirty verses, constituting
seven Sūktas of the twentieth book of this Veda.

कुन्ति कुन्ति, अयस्, m. pl., N. of a people;
(इस्), m. sing. the prince of this people, also called
Kunti-bhoja; कुन्ति is, according to different authori-
ties, a son of either Dharmanetra, or of Netra and
grandson of Dharma, or of Kratha, or of Vidarbha
and father of Dhṛṣṭa, or of Supārśva and grandson
of Sampāti and great-grandson of Garuḍa; (ई), f.
a N. of Pṛthā, the daughter of a Yādava prince
named Śūra, who gave her to his childless cousin
Kunti or Kunti-bhoja, by whom she was adopted.
She afterwards became one of the two wives of
Pāṇḍu. (On one occasion before her marriage she
paid such respect to the powerful sage Durvāsas that
he taught her an incantation or charm, by virtue of
which she was to have a child by any god she liked
to invoke. Out of curiosity she invoked the Sun,
by whom she had a child, cf. कर्ण; but the Sun
afterwards restored to her her maidenhood. Soon
after his marriage Pāṇḍu retired to the woods to
indulge his passion for hunting. There he killed a
male and female deer, who turned out to be a Ṛṣi
and his wife in the form of these animals. The sage
cursed Pāṇḍu and predicted that he would die in the
embrace of one of his wives. Hence Pāṇḍu lived
apart from Kunti, but with his approval she made
use of her charm and had three sons, Yudhiṣṭhira,
Bhīma, and Arjuna, by the three deities Dharma,
Vāyu, and Indra respectively; cf. माद्री); N. of a
Rākṣasī; the wife of a Brāhman; the plant Bos-
wellia Thurifera; a fragrant resin (= गुग्गुलु).
—कुन्ति-नन्दन, अस्, m. a son of Kuntī (the final
being sometimes shortened in a comp.), either of
the three elder Pāṇḍava princes.
—कुन्ति-भोज, अस्,
m., N. of a Yādava prince, king of the Kuntis, who
adopted Kuntī.
—कुन्ती-सुत, अस्, m. a son of Kuntī.
कुन्तिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.

कुन्थ् कुन्थ्, cl. 1. P. कुन्थति, -थितुम्,
to hurt, injure; to suffer pain, want, &c.;
to be distressed; cl. 9. P. कुथ्नाति, to injure; to
cling to; to twine round or be connected with, em-
brace; [cf. Lat. quatio, per-cutio.]

कुन्थु कुन्थु, उस्, m., N. of the sixth Jaina
Cakravartin or emperor in Bhārata; also of the
seventeenth Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī.

कुन्द कुन्द, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr.
rt. 3. कु), a kind of jasmine, Jasminum Multiflorum
or Pubescens; (अस्), m. fragrant oleander, Nerium
Odorum [cf. करवीर]; Olibanum, the resin of the
plant Boswellia Thurifera; a turner's lathe; one of
Kuvera's nine treasures; the number ‘nine;’ an epi-
thet of Viṣṇu; N. of a mountain.
—कुन्द-कर,
अस्, m. a turner.
—कुन्द-कुन्दाचार्य (˚द-आच्˚),
अस्, m., N. of the author of the Pañcāstikāyasaṅgraha-
sūtra.
—कुन्द-माला, f. title of a work.
—कुन्द-
[]
समान-दन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, one whose teeth are like
the jasmine.

कुन्दक, अस्, m. the plant Boswellia Thurifera;
the resin of this plant.

कुन्दिनी, f. an assemblage of lotus flowers or of
jasmines.
कुन्दम कुन्दम, अस्, m. a cat.

कुन्दर कुन्दर, अस्, m. a sort of grass; an
epithet of Viṣṇu; [cf. कण्डुर and कुन्द.]

कुन्दु कुन्दु, उस्, m. a mouse, a rat; (उस्),
f. the resin of the plant Boswellia Thurifera; gum
olibanum or frankincense.

कुन्दुर, अस्, m. or कुन्दुरु, उस्, m. f. the resin
of the plant Boswellia Thurifera.

कुन्दुरुक, अस्, ई, m. f. the resin of the plant Bos-
wellia Thurifera; (ई), f. the plant Boswellia Thurifera.

कुन्द्र् कुन्द्र्, cl. 10. P. कुन्द्रयति, -यितुम्,
to tell a lie; [cf. कुद् and गुन्द्र्.]
